summary: Canvas gun boots, camouflage foliage and nets readable from the battle camera, helicopter fairings seated on the hull, the Merkava's arrowhead turret, matte dark steel and ID panels, rounded truck cab roofs, moulded boat motors and graded rust.
rationale: Geometry, surface and colour changes across many families: one matched studio sheet shows a representative of each area. Camouflage is shown at a seed whose crew carries it, since which vehicles are camouflaged comes from each vehicle's seed.
